title: SAML 2.0 setup wizard: connector probing, metadata roundtrip validation, and graceful fallback
creator: Asha Patel
description: Implement a resilient SAML 2.0 setup wizard that performs active connector probing, roundtrip metadata validation, and clear admin-facing remediation guidance. This ticket covers backend metadata exchange endpoints, client-side UX for admins, validation heuristics for common IdP misconfigurations, and a fallback policy to keep customer sign-in available while preserving security controls.
steps: 1) Add POST /api/v1/sso/saml/validate-metadata endpoint that accepts raw IdP XML and returns structured validation results. 2) Implement connector-probing worker that attempts ACS/SSO URL GET/POST exchanges in a sandbox with timeouts and TLS checks. 3) Enhance wizard frontend with real-time diagnostics panel and suggested fixes for signature/certificate/clock skew mismatches. 4) Store validation snapshots in audit logs with redactable keys. 5) Implement canary rollout: enable wizard for 10% orgs then 100% after telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: - Endpoint returns deterministic validation codes and human-readable remediation steps. - Frontend shows diagnostics and allows one-click retry after updating metadata. - Audit log contains redacted metadata snapshot with trace id. - E2E tests simulate metadata variants (missing entityID, bad cert, expired cert, sender mismatch) and assert appropriate detection. - No regression in login SLO during canary (latency & error rate).
notes: Trade-offs: deep validation increases surface area to false-positives (e.g., custom IdP configs). Decided to prioritize clear remediation over strict blocking; wizard will surface warnings and offer 'Proceed with caution' when non-fatal issues detected. KV caching for metadata will be TTLed to 15 minutes to balance freshness vs load.

2026-03-05 -- Marta Gomez: Security review kickoff. Need to ensure audit logs encrypt sensitive fields and we have redaction policy documented.
2026-03-08 -- Oliver Wang: Added probe worker with retries and jitter. Observed a 0.12% increase in background task CPU under synthetic load; acceptable for P1.

implementation_notes: - Use existing xmlsec binding used by auth service to avoid a new dependency. - Validation returns a standardized list of issue codes (SAML-MISSING_ENTITYID, SAML-BAD_CERT, SAML-CLOCK_SKEW, SAML-ACS_MISMATCH). - Audit entries stored in events table with columns: trace_id, org_id, redacted_metadata_blob, validator_result_code.
qa_plan: - Unit tests for parser and individual validator rules. - Integration test that posts real IdP metadata from test fixtures. - Staging canary with 10 orgs, collect telemetry for 72 hours, then expand. - Run external pen test on validation endpoints.
rollback_plan: - Feature flagged via remote config. If increased auth errors > 1% vs baseline during canary window, immediately disable wizard flag and revert PRs that introduced non-flagged changes. Maintain ability to replay metadata validation offline using stored snapshots.
owner_notes: Coordinate with legal on retention of metadata snapshots. Notify account managers about potential admin-reach outs for orgs with flagged issues.
estimated_impact: Reduces onboarding failures by surfacing actionable fixes; expected to cut support SSO tickets by ~35% for new SAML connectors.
